attributes.residual: UNCHANGED and now much better bounded. All three functions share ONE mechanism at their bank-name lookup preheader: target emits `li rIdx,0` then `addi rOff,rIdx,0` (MWCC's register-move form) while MWCC emits a second independent `li rOff,0`. Sites: AudioUnloadPart +0x24 (addi r29,r31,0), AudioBankLoadName +0x34 (addi r25,r30,0), AudioBankQueueName +0x34 (addi r29,r28,0). All three loop bodies are byte-identical copies of one another, so any solution transfers to all three at once. NEW EVIDENCE from this pass: the opcode is invariant under how the offset induction variable is CONSTRUCTED, not merely under how it is spelled. AXIS1 (delete the explicit offset local entirely; write `(u8*)gAudioBankTbl + i * 292 + 20` and let MWCC build the derived IV itself) - MWCC did strength-reduce (insn count stayed 95/95, one offset IV with +=292 at the latch) and STILL emitted `li r29,0` for the preheader init; real 2 -> 6. AXIS2 (typed walk `((AudioRomMode*)gAudioBankTbl)->banks[i].name`, stride driven by sizeof(AudioRomModeBankEntry) == 292, AudioRomMode.banks at offset 20 - both already-verified file-local views in this TU) - again `li`, real 2 -> 12, with an extra address-staging addi displaced. In BOTH probes the residual cluster printed byte-identically to baseline (`replace T[9:10]@24-28=['addi'] O[9:10]@24-28=['li']`), i.e. two genuinely distinct axes produced the same A/B result on the cluster, which per AGENTS.md kills the axis. CONCLUSION: this is not an initializer-spelling or induction-form choice at all - it is MWCC's register allocator choosing to REMATERIALIZE a constant-zero web instead of extending a copy's live range. Cross-project corroboration that it is an allocator decision and not a source property: src/game/audio/dcsdrv.c::dcsHandleRequest case 17 exhibits the SAME mechanism with the OPPOSITE sign (target rematerializes two `li`s, MWCC emits li+copy) from the source form `output[0] = resultOffset = 0;`, and attempt.parked.dcshandlerequest-wrapper-web-order.20260831.v3 records 7 dead forms there. The family now spans at least 12 recorded functions across 8 TUs (this trio, fn_8006E654/newcam, LoadPdataFile/psfx, fn_800C37C4, ProcessCritterList, DcsSampleAllocUpload, InitControls, fn_80051164, fn_80051E1C/gamemain, do_camera). WEBFRANK-READY: the residual is a single-instruction opcode substitution whose soundness obligation is small and machine-checkable - rewrite `li rD,0` to `addi rD,rS,0` only where a local backward scan proves rS is defined by `li rS,0` with no intervening definition of rS and no intervening branch target between the definition and the rewrite site, so the two instructions are provably value-equivalent. This is a dataflow-equivalence rule, NOT a renaming/permutation rule, so it needs its own audit class alongside the existing copy_register_fields rules. No rule was authored here per lane instructions.
